name: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker
tagline: The Modern Link Routing, Geolocation, Smart ToS Uncloaking, and Automated Compliance Engine (100% Feature Complete)
description: Transform raw referral links into branded short links while automating FTC legal disclosures, Amazon §6 ToS uncloaking, dynamic geo-targeting, DOM-safe keyword auto-linking, Stripe payment links, and broken link monitoring without third-party SaaS fees.

keyFeatures.title: Custom Post Type (salc_link) & Permalinks
keyFeatures.description: Convert long referral URLs into clean links using custom prefixes (^go/{slug} or ^go/{category}/{slug}) with transient caching (24h).

keyFeatures.title: Redirect Engine (301 / 302 / 307 / 200 iFrame)
keyFeatures.description: Full support for 301 permanent, 302 temporary, 307 temporary redirect (default uncached), and 200 iFrame Mask with branded gradient bar.

keyFeatures.title: Automatic SEO & Robots Control
keyFeatures.description: Automatically appends rel="nofollow sponsored" + target="_blank", sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header, and adds Disallow: /go/ in robots.txt.

keyFeatures.title: Smart ToS Uncloaking (Amazon Associates §6)
keyFeatures.description: Regex detects amazon.* and amzn.to, rendering raw destination URL on frontend while beacon-tracking clicks via navigator.sendBeacon.

keyFeatures.title: FTC Auto-Disclosure Injector
keyFeatures.description: Auto-inserts accessible <aside role="note"> banner in top, bottom, or before_first_link with 4 visual styles (Callout, Badge, Minimal, Subtle).

keyFeatures.title: GA-Style Local Click Analytics
keyFeatures.description: Records clicks to local DB table wp_salc_clicks with bot filtering (30+ signatures), GDPR IPv4/IPv6 anonymization, Cloudflare geo, 7 charts, and CSV export.

keyFeatures.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
keyFeatures.description: DOMDocument + XPath regex converts keywords to cloaked links, skipping h1-h6, code, pre, script, and existing <a> tags with per-post & global limits.

keyFeatures.title: Conditional Routing (Geo, OS, Device, Country)
keyFeatures.description: Route visitors dynamically by OS (macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, Linux), Device, Browser, Language, and Country (GeoIP / Cloudflare).

keyFeatures.title: Stripe Payment Links Integration
keyFeatures.description: Direct go/checkout -> Stripe Checkout Session. REST webhook (salc/v1/stripe-webhook) tracks revenue and conversion count.

keyFeatures.title: Deal Expiration & Nightly Health Scanner
keyFeatures.description: Auto-expire links by date or click cap -> 302 fallback or 410 page. Nightly HEAD batch 20 health scanner pings destination URLs and emails broken link reports.

keyFeatures.title: A/B Split Testing & Traffic Rotation
keyFeatures.description: Distribute inbound clicks across multiple target URLs with percentage weights (weighted random) or sequential rotation.

keyFeatures.title: Dynamic UTM & Query Parameter Forwarding
keyFeatures.description: Allowlist forwarding for utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, gclid, fbclid, msclkid, wbraid while preserving target existing params.

features: Target URL Health & Broken Link Scanner

documentationSections.title: Phase 1: Installation & Setup
documentationSections.content: Uploading smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.zip in WordPress Admin Dashboard and configuring global rules.
steps: Upload ZIP via WP Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
Activate plugin. Activator creates wp_salc_clicks table and seeds global defaults.
Go to Affiliate Links -> Settings. Confirm Global Prefix (go), Anonymize IP (ON), Smart ToS (ON), and Default HTTP Redirect (307).
Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes to register top-priority rewrite rules.

documentationSections.title: Phase 2: Creating Your First Link
documentationSections.content: Creating clean, branded referral URLs with custom post type salc_link and metaboxes.
steps: Navigate to Affiliate Links -> Add New Link.
Enter Title (e.g. 'Best VPN Deal') and Target Destination URL (e.g. https://merchant.com/?aff_id=123).
Select Redirect Type (307 Temporary Recommended) and toggle rel="nofollow / sponsored".
Assign Categories & Tags (aff_category / aff_tag) and click Publish.

documentationSections.title: Phase 3: Advanced Engine & Integrations [PRO]
documentationSections.content: Configuring Conditional Routing, Stripe Checkout Links, Keyword Auto-Linker, and Expiration.
steps: Conditional Routing: Add rules based on OS (macOS -> Mac offer), Device (Mobile -> App Store), or Country (DE -> German landing).
Stripe Payment: Enter Stripe Secret Key sk_live_... & Webhook Secret in Settings. Toggle Enable Stripe on link metabox and enter Price ID.
Keyword Auto-Linker: Go to Settings -> Auto-Linker, set max limits per post, and add keyword-to-link mapping rules.
Deal Expiration: Set UTC expiration datetime or click cap, fallback URL (302 redirect), or expired message (410 page).

documentationSections.title: Phase 4: Compliance & Analytics
documentationSections.content: Activating FTC Legal Disclosures, Smart ToS Uncloaking, and inspecting local click statistics.
steps: Go to Settings -> FTC Disclosure. Choose position (before_first_link, top, bottom) and style (Callout, Badge, Minimal, Subtle).
Verify Smart ToS Uncloaking: Test an Amazon URL. Raw link renders on frontend while beacon tracks clicks via navigator.sendBeacon.
Go to Affiliate Links -> Statistics to inspect real-time click charts, device breakdown, top performing links, and export CSV.
